user_approval_text:
Approved: protocol V4 (commit e30ced94) with the amendments below, as V4.1. Produce the V4.1 JSON and verify that its diff from V4 is limited to these amendments. Then create the approval record with the V4.1 SHA-256 and this text. This constitutes explicit Phase 2 approval of V4.1; do not wait for further confirmation if the diff check passes. If an amendment cannot be implemented as written, stop and report instead of launching.

Continuous regret. Primary mean-regret quantities use unzeroed continuous cost differences. The 0.10-s near-tie applies only to set-membership metrics (optimal set, top-1 agreement).
Paired filter contrasts.
Replace the twelve per-source filter rates in the primary family with paired, state-matched, layout-level differences from R2.
Compute these differences for R4-old, R4-maze and R5c, in two rates: the excluded-but-safe rate and the complete-exclusion-despite-safety rate.
Add the R2 levels of both rates, giving eight filter quantities.
The primary family becomes 13 quantities, with Bonferroni confidence 1 − 0.05/13.
Per-source rates and admitted-but-unsafe rates move to the descriptive panel with 95% intervals.
Memo rules, fixed now. Use τ = 0.10 on rate differences.
Condition A. A head's complete-exclusion-despite-safety difference from R2 has a lower bound above τ, and R5c's difference does not. Then report that the learned motion pathway causes false safety exclusions.
Condition B. Either (i) the R2 complete-exclusion-despite-safety level, counting only states whose binding rule is memory clearance or stopping projection, has a lower bound above τ; or (ii) R5c's difference from R2 also exceeds τ. Then report that the motion-dependent gate is over-conservative independent of prediction quality.
If both A and B hold, the single recommendation addresses B first.
If neither holds, the recommendation comes from the regret decision table.
Inconclusive regret quantities support neither stopping nor continuing; state this explicitly.
Order and caps. Run layouts in the order 00, 04, 01, 05, 02, 06, 03, 07. Raise the wall cap to 72 hours and the CPU cap proportionally. All other caps are unchanged.
Reference coverage. The primary reference is unchanged. Add a labelled secondary regret for physically safe endpoints inside the 0.46-m inflated region:
their progress is computed from the nearest inflation-free cell reachable through non-inflated free space;
the length of that path is added.
Report regret coverage by clearance stratum under both references.
Localisation covariate. Record the controller's believed-versus-true pose error at every sampled state. Report regret and filter results stratified by it, descriptively.
Historical re-render check. Approved as proposed, run as a separate owner under its own caps, before Phase 2 launch. Report its results alongside Phase 2; it does not gate launch.

Everything else in V4 stands. Stop after the audit, branch panel and decision memo.
